CustomField.description: Formula field to show the ABN validation status with images
CustomField.formula: TEXT(ABN_Validation_Status__c) + " " + IMAGE( CASE(Text(ABN_Validation_Status__c), "Active", "/img/msg_icons/confirm24.png", "Cancelled", "/img/msg_icons/error24.png", "Validation Error", "/img/msg_icons/error24.png", "Validation Inprogress", "/img/msg_icons/info24.png", "/s.gif"), "ABN Validation Status")
CustomField.label: ABN Status
